title: Area2D doesn't get monitored by get_overlapping_areas for a small amount of time after toggling+retoggling monitorable
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducable in 4.3-stable

### System information

Godot v4.3.stable - Windows 10.0.26100 - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce MX350 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.6119) - 11th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-1135G7 @ 2.40GHz (8 Threads)

### Issue description

After setting monitorable of an Area2D to false and then setting it back to true in another frame, the Area2D can't be monitored by calling get_overlapping_areas() in another Area2D (that overlaps normally without toggling monitorable). This issue then somehow disappears after a small time in which the Area2D comes monitorable again.
I have seen reports on this issue as old as some godot 2.x versions.
A solution for an older version was shown in this pull: [#22933](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/22933)

### Steps to reproduce

Very simple reproduction:
- create a 2D scene
- add 2 **Area2D**s (A and B) with a **CollisionShape2D**
- Make sure their shapes overlap in the scene
- **Area2D** A: add a script that toggles **monitorable** (e.g. on button press - so the change happens on different frames)
- **Area2D** B: add a script which prints **get_overlapping_areas()**

You should see after toggling monitorable from false to true that **get_overlapping_areas()** doesn't return true for a small time.
In some circumstances (like the **MRP**) the **Area2D** A doesnt even get un-monitorable and it still prints true every time

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

press space to toggle A's monitorable
**get_overlapping_areas()** gets printed on every **_process()**

[issue-project.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/22539038/issue-project.zip)
